corrections.old_text: ህን ፡ ዓለም ፡ ነዳያን ፡ ልብደ ፡ ሠሪ ፡ ዓሣ ፡
corrections.corrected_text: ህን ፡ ዓለም ፡ ነዳያን ፡ ልብድ ፡ ሠሪ ፡ ዓሣ ፡
corrections.reason: The word printed is 'ልብድ ፡ ሠሪ' (tentmaker / felt-maker, referring to St. Paul/Apostles), with 6th-order 'ድ' (ሳድስ) clearly visible.
The verb is 3rd person plural 'ይነቅፋሉ' (they criticize/blaspheme) with 4th-order 'ፋ' (ራብዕ), misread as 'ፉ'.
Rejoined across the line wrap, the Ge'ez plural agent noun is 'ፈጻምያነ ፡ ሕግ' (fulfillers of the law), with 4th-order 'ጻ' (ራብዕ) at the end of line 25.
The parenthetical gloss quotes the Ge'ez root text from line 18: 'ምግባረ ፡ ሠናይ ፡ አልብየ' (I do not have good works). Visually 'አልብየ' is printed before the closing parenthesis.
